description: Records a payment against a bill/accession/registration. Unlike other modules, organizationId and branchId are supplied in the request body rather than the path.

body.paymentMode: enum, required - CASH | CARD | UPI | NET_BANKING | CHEQUE | WALLET | CORPORATE_CREDIT
body.paymentStatus: enum, optional - SUCCESS | PENDING | FAILED | PARTIAL, default SUCCESS

validation: accessionId must reference an existing accession (NOT NULL FK)
billingMasterId must reference an existing bill (NOT NULL FK)
patientRegistrationId must reference an existing registration (NOT NULL FK)
paymentMode must not be null and must reference a code in payment_mode_master for the same organization + branch (FK fk_payment_payment_mode)
amountPaid must not be null and must be >= 0 (CHECK) - see database_gap note regarding zero amounts
paymentStatus, if provided, must be one of SUCCESS, PENDING, FAILED, PARTIAL (CHECK)

errors.condition: billingMasterId, accessionId, or patientRegistrationId does not reference an existing row
paymentMode is not a valid code in payment_mode_master
transactionReference duplicates an existing payment's transactionReference

relationships: payment.payment_mode -> payment_mode_master.payment_mode_code (organization_id, branch_id scoped, FK fk_payment_payment_mode)
constraints: payment_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUCCESS' CHECK IN (SUCCESS, PENDING, FAILED, PARTIAL)

notes: DB GAP 1: amount_paid has CHECK (amount_paid >= 0), not > 0, so amountPaid = 0.00 is currently accepted by the database (database/api_contracts_test/015_payment.sql API-T122 confirms 'INSERT 0 1 — amount 0.00 accepted'). DB GAP 2: transaction_reference has no UNIQUE constraint or index anywhere in the schema, so duplicate transaction references are currently accepted (API-T123 confirms this). Per the task's DB GAP rule, the 400/409 error conditions above reflect the INTENDED API behavior, not what the database currently enforces - the database itself needs a CHECK (amount_paid > 0) and a UNIQUE constraint/index on (organization_id, branch_id, transaction_reference) to actually back these contracts. NOTE ON SOURCE DATA: docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx has these two gap notes swapped between its API-T122 and API-T123 rows (the note text for the amount check is attached to the T123 row and vice versa) - this contract uses the corrected mapping, verified directly against database/api_contracts_test/015_payment.sql and database/schema/026_payment.sql.
